candidates.reason: Direct unit-test surface for scrapy/contracts/__init__.py, which currently raises TypeError("Contracts don't support async callbacks") from Contract.add_pre_hook and Contract.add_post_hook (and mis-handles the Deferred produced by iterate_spider_output in ContractsManager._clean_req). DemoSpider.returns_request_async (coroutine callback) and DemoSpider.returns_async_gen (async generator callback) are the fixtures exercising async callbacks, and test_returns_async, test_pre_hook_async_callback, test_pre_hook_async_generator and test_post_hook_async_generator currently assert that error/TypeError behavior, so they must be updated to assert successful awaited output once async callbacks are supported. The pre/post-process and returns/scrapes hooks also need re-verification because output is currently materialized synchronously with list(iterate_spider_output(...)).

End-to-end integration surface for the contracts feature: these tests generate a real spider and run the `scrapy check` command, which drives ContractsManager/Contract hooks through the scraper. This is the user-visible path (issue #6681) where an async callback is awaited by the downloader/scraper machinery, so it is a candidate for an added/updated async-callback regression check (e.g. an `async def parse` variant of the generated contract spider).
